subScenes.name: 寻找文具
subScenes.description: 顾客询问笔记本和笔的位置，店员指引。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have any mechanical pencils?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客询问特定文具是否有货

followUps.text: Yes, we have them in the stationery aisle, right next to the erasers.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，在文具区，就在橡皮旁边。

followUps.text: I'm sorry, we're out of stock right now, but we'll get a new shipment tomorrow.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，目前缺货，但明天会有新货到。

followUps.text: We don't have mechanical pencils, but these retractable lead pencils work similarly and are on sale.
followUps.text_cn: 我们没有自动铅笔，但这些伸缩铅笔功能类似，现在正在促销。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客询问具体文具是否存在时，店员可能有库存、缺货或推荐替代品三种回应，帮助学习者应对不同库存状况。

qaPairs.triggerText: Are you looking for something specific today?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您今天有特别想找的东西吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 店员主动询问顾客需求，引导购买

followUps.text: Yes, I need a set of colored markers for my art class.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，我需要一套彩色马克笔给美术课用。

followUps.text: I'm not sure—I just need some pens and maybe a notebook, but I'm not sure what's best.
followUps.text_cn: 我不太确定，我只需要一些笔和一本笔记本，但不知道选哪个好。

followUps.text: Just browsing—I might buy something if I see a good deal.
followUps.text_cn: 我只是看看，如果看到划算的可能会买。

qaPairs.usageNote: 店员常主动询问需求，顾客回应可能因目标明确性不同而有差异，学习者需掌握三种自然回应方式。

qaPairs.triggerText: Can I get a discount if I buy more than five items?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 如果我买超过五件，能打折吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客询问批量购买折扣政策

followUps.text: Absolutely! We offer a 10% discount on purchases of six or more items.
followUps.text_cn: 当然可以！买六件及以上享受10%折扣。

followUps.text: Sorry, we don't do discounts on stationery, but I can throw in a free pencil case with your purchase.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，文具不打折，但我可以送您一个免费铅笔盒。

followUps.text: I'd need to check with the manager—I'll be right back.
followUps.text_cn: 我得问问经理，马上回来。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客询问批量折扣时，店员可能直接同意、拒绝但提供替代优惠，或需请示上级，学习者应熟悉这三种典型回应。

subScenes.name: 询问规格
subScenes.description: 顾客确认笔记本大小和笔的类型，店员解答。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have this notebook in A5 size?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 这种笔记本有A5尺寸的吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客询问具体文具的尺寸规格

followUps.text: Yes, we have A5 in both lined and grid pages. Would you like to see them?
followUps.text_cn: 有的，A5尺寸有横线和网格两种，要看一下吗？

followUps.text: Sorry, we only carry A4 for this model, but we have a similar one in A5 over there.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，这个型号只有A4，但那边有类似款式的A5。

followUps.text: Unfortunately, we don’t stock A5 for this brand. Would you like me to check if we can order it?
followUps.text_cn: 很抱歉，这个品牌没有A5尺寸。要我帮您查一下能否订货吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于顾客明确询问某款文具的具体尺寸，店员需根据库存情况给出三种典型回应：有货、有替代品、可订货。

qaPairs.triggerText: What’s the difference between these two pens?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客对比两款相似文具的规格差异

followUps.text: This one has a fine tip (0.5mm) for precise writing, while the other has a medium tip (0.7mm) for smoother flow.
followUps.text_cn: 这支笔是细尖（0.5毫米），适合精准书写；另一支是中尖（0.7毫米），书写更顺滑。

followUps.text: The first is water-resistant ink, ideal for left-handed users; the second is quick-drying but smudges easily.
followUps.text_cn: 第一支是防水墨水，适合左撇子；第二支速干但容易晕染。

followUps.text: They’re the same pen, just different colors. The price is identical.
followUps.text_cn: 这两支笔是一样的，只是颜色不同，价格也一样。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客常通过对比询问文具细节，店员需根据功能、墨水、外观等维度给出真实差异说明。

qaPairs.triggerText: Is this pencil set suitable for kids?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 这套铅笔适合孩子用吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客询问文具是否适合特定人群（如儿童）

followUps.text: Yes, these are non-toxic, thick-barrel pencils with soft leads—perfect for small hands.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，这些铅笔无毒、笔杆粗、铅芯软，特别适合孩子的小手使用。

followUps.text: They’re standard pencils—fine for older kids, but younger ones might find them too thin.
followUps.text_cn: 这是普通铅笔，适合大一点的孩子，但太小的孩子会觉得太细。

followUps.text: Actually, we have a special kids’ line with ergonomic grips and break-resistant leads—would you like to see those?
followUps.text_cn: 其实我们有专为儿童设计的系列，带防滑握柄和防断铅芯，要看一下吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 家长常询问文具是否适合儿童，店员需根据安全性、握感、铅芯硬度等给出针对性回应，避免笼统回答。

subScenes.name: 确认价格
subScenes.description: 顾客询问总价，店员告知并确认商品数量。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 文具店：服务员告知价格，顾客回应

followUps.text: I'll take it.
followUps.text_cn: 我买了。

followUps.text: Can you give me a discount? I'm buying three sets.
followUps.text_cn: 能便宜点吗？我要买三套。

followUps.text: Do you have a cheaper option? This is a bit over my budget.
followUps.text_cn: 有更便宜的吗？这个超了我的预算。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于顾客听到价格后的自然回应，涵盖接受、议价、换品三种典型反应，符合真实购物场景。

qaPairs.triggerText: How much is this pencil case?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 文具店：顾客主动询问单件商品价格

followUps.text: It's $2.99, but it's on sale today for $2.50.
followUps.text_cn: 原价2.99美元，今天促销价2.50美元。

followUps.text: Sorry, we don't sell that item anymore — it's been discontinued.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，这款已经停售了。

followUps.text: It's $3.50, and if you buy two, you get 10% off.
followUps.text_cn: 3.5美元，买两个打九折。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客询问价格时，服务员可能给出标准价、缺货通知或促销信息，覆盖真实服务中的三种常见回应。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 文具店：收银员报总价，顾客确认是否接受

followUps.text: Perfect, I'll pay with my card.
followUps.text_cn: 很好，我刷卡。

followUps.text: Wait, I think I got the wrong item — can I swap this notebook for the cheaper one?
followUps.text_cn: 等等，我拿错东西了，能换回便宜的那本笔记本吗？

followUps.text: Do you accept coupons? I have a 10% off voucher.
followUps.text_cn: 你们收优惠券吗？我有一张九折券。

qaPairs.usageNote: 收银员报总价后，顾客可能直接付款、要求换货或使用优惠券，三种回应体现真实购物中的灵活决策。

subScenes.name: 支付结账
subScenes.description: 顾客选择付款方式，店员完成收款并道谢。

qaPairs.triggerText: How would you like to pay?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 文具店结账时收银员询问支付方式

followUps.text: I'll pay by card, please.
followUps.text_cn: 我刷卡，谢谢。

followUps.text: Do you accept cash? I only have bills today.
followUps.text_cn: 你们收现金吗？我今天只有现金。

followUps.text: Can I use Apple Pay? My card’s not working.
followUps.text_cn: 可以用Apple Pay吗？我的卡刷不了了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 结账时最常见的支付方式询问，用户需根据自身情况选择支付方式并清晰表达。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 收银员报出总价后，顾客决定支付方式或提出疑问

followUps.text: Here’s $15. Keep the change.
followUps.text_cn: 给你15美元，零钱不用找了。

followUps.text: Wait, I think I got the wrong price—I only bought 3 pens and a notebook.
followUps.text_cn: 等一下，我觉得价格不对，我只买了3支笔和一个笔记本。

followUps.text: I’ll just take the notebook then—I don’t have enough right now.
followUps.text_cn: 那我只买笔记本吧，我现在钱不够。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客在得知总价后可能选择支付、质疑价格或调整购物内容，需灵活应对不同反应。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have a loyalty card?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 收银员询问是否使用会员卡享受折扣

followUps.text: Yes, here it is. I forgot to use it last time.
followUps.text_cn: 有，给您。上次忘了用。

followUps.text: No, but can I sign up now?
followUps.text_cn: 没有，但我现在能注册吗？

followUps.text: No thanks, I’m just buying a few things today.
followUps.text_cn: 不用了，我今天就买几样东西。

qaPairs.usageNote: 会员卡询问是文具店常见促销环节，顾客可能接受、申请或婉拒，需掌握自然回应方式。

subScenes.name: 礼貌告别
subScenes.description: 顾客致谢，店员回应并欢迎再次光临。

qaPairs.triggerText: Thank you for shopping with us!
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 文具店结账后，店员礼貌告别

followUps.text: Thank you, have a great day!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢，祝你今天愉快！

followUps.text: I’ll be back next week—I need more notebooks.
followUps.text_cn: 我下周还来，还需要买些笔记本。

followUps.text: Thanks! The pens were perfect.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！这些笔太棒了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于结账后店员道别时的自然回应，体现礼貌与满意度

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 店员在顾客离开前再次温馨告别

followUps.text: You too!
followUps.text_cn: 你也是！

followUps.text: Thanks for your help—I really appreciate it.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢你的帮助，我真的很感激。

followUps.text: Same to you! Bye!
followUps.text_cn: 你也是！再见！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于店员使用更口语化告别语时，顾客的自然回应

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 店员根据顾客购买行为预判再次光临并道别

followUps.text: Hope so! I’m running out of erasers again.
followUps.text_cn: 希望如此！我的橡皮又快用完了。

followUps.text: I’m not sure—I’ll check with my teacher first.
followUps.text_cn: 我不确定，得先问问老师。

followUps.text: Definitely! Your stationery is the best in town.
followUps.text_cn: 一定！你们的文具是城里最好的。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于店员基于顾客行为做出预测性告别时，顾客的多样化回应
